name: BRIGHT-Pro
intro: BRIGHT-Pro 是面向推理密集型检索的专家标注基准。它在 BRIGHT 的 StackExchange 子集上，把 739 个查询分解为带权重的推理方面，并在 526,319 篇统一语料中标注方面级证据；评测同时覆盖静态检索和固定 175 查询的 agentic search。
org: Yale University, National University of Singapore, NYU Shanghai
build_method: 领域专家方面分解与加权, 原正例复核, 网页证据扩充, 双人独立复核
metric: alpha-nDCG@k, Weighted Aspect Recall, NDCG, Recall, Aspect Coverage, Overall Quality, AER
task_type: 检索, Agent搜索, 证据综合
eval_feature: 方面多样性感知的静态检索, 固定轮次与自适应停止的Agentic search, 引用证据综合
scale: 739个查询, 7个领域, 526,319篇统一语料; 175查询agentic子集
build_method_en: Field-expert aspect decomposition and weighting, original-positive re-audit, web evidence expansion, independent second review
eval_feature_en: Aspect-diversity-aware static retrieval, fixed-round and adaptive-stop agentic search, citation-grounded synthesis
intro_en: BRIGHT-Pro is an expert-annotated benchmark for reasoning-intensive retrieval. Built from the BRIGHT StackExchange subset, it decomposes 739 queries into weighted reasoning aspects and annotates aspect-level evidence in a unified corpus of 526,319 documents; evaluation covers static retrieval and agentic search on a fixed 175-query subset.
scale_en: 739 queries, 7 domains, 526,319-document unified corpus; 175-query agentic subset
metric_en: alpha-nDCG@k, Weighted Aspect Recall, NDCG, Recall, Aspect Coverage, Overall Quality, AER
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Start from BRIGHT StackExchange reasoning-intensive retrieval queries"] --> B["Field experts decompose each information need into compact reasoning aspects"]
    B --> C["Assign Likert importance scores and normalize them into aspect weights"]
    C --> D["Re-audit original BRIGHT positives, assign them to aspects, discard weak passages, and merge overlaps"]
    D --> E["Collect new aspect-relevant positive documents through web or AI-assisted search"]
    E --> F["Clean pages, remove boilerplate, manually trim noise, and segment multi-aspect pages into aspect-specific positives"]
    F --> G["Iteratively refine aspect schemas and run second-annotator checks for aspects, weights, and evidence credibility"]
    G --> H["Evaluate static retrieval with alpha-nDCG, weighted aspect recall, NDCG, and recall"]
    G --> I["Evaluate retrievers inside an LLM agentic search loop with citation-grounded answer judging"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从BRIGHT的StackExchange推理密集检索查询出发"] --> B["领域专家将每个信息需求分解为紧凑的推理aspect"]
    B --> C["给aspect分配Likert重要性分并归一化为权重"]
    C --> D["重新审核原BRIGHT正例，分配到aspect，丢弃弱相关段落并合并重叠内容"]
    D --> E["通过网页或AI辅助搜索收集新的aspect相关正例文档"]
    E --> F["清理页面、去除模板噪声、人工裁剪，并把多aspect页面切成aspect级正例"]
    F --> G["迭代修订aspect结构，并由第二标注员检查aspect、权重和证据可信度"]
    G --> H["用alpha-nDCG、加权aspect召回、NDCG和Recall做静态检索评估"]
    G --> I["把检索器接入LLM agentic搜索循环，并用带引用答案评判最终质量"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.04018. The diagram follows the paper's BRIGHT StackExchange starting point; seven-domain, 739-query sampling; expert aspect decomposition, rationales, Likert-to-normalized weights, original-positive re-audit, overlap merging, search expansion, FireCrawl cleaning, aspect-level segmentation, iterative schema refinement, and independent same-field second review. It also distinguishes static evaluation on the 526,319-document unified corpus from the fixed 175-query agentic subset, including fixed/adaptive rounds, top-5 search results per round, GPT-5 judging, aspect coverage, overall quality, and AER.
